exhibitions.title: Dressed for the Future
exhibitions.description: Portraits and stories from ten years of graduates who found their grad outfit at the Boutique.
exhibitions.content:
Ten years, thousands of graduates. This exhibition brings together portraits and first-person stories from students who found their grad outfit at the Boutique.

About the exhibition

Curated with former volunteers, the show pairs each portrait with a short reflection on what the day meant.

  • Free admission
  • Wheelchair accessible
